Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve intent and certainty. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "for Friday's check of the shared bicycle shed, could someone look at the rear drain and the door latch, since those are the two things we need to know about before moving the spare pump. the pump is on the lower shelf by the entrance now, and the cabinet with the blue label is where it should go if it is okay to move it. If the rear drain is clear and the latch will stay shut without a person holding the door, please move the pump into that cabinet and change its location on the paper inventory by the entrance. If either the drain is not clear or the latch will not stay shut unless someone holds the door, don't move the pump from the lower shelf. Instead, leave a note on the notice board saying which check did not pass, and let the caretaker know before noon on Friday. Please make sure the note is about the drain or the latch, not just that the pump is still downstairs, because the caretaker needs to know what needs attention. We should use the same check for both parts before deciding which of the two actions to take.", "output": "For Friday’s check of the shared bicycle shed, please inspect the rear drain and the door latch before moving the spare pump. The pump is currently on the lower shelf by the entrance. If the rear drain is clear and the latch stays shut without someone holding the door, move the pump into the blue-labeled cabinet and update its location on the paper inventory by the entrance. If either the drain is not clear or the latch will not stay shut unless someone holds the door, do not move the pump from the lower shelf. Instead, leave a note on the notice board identifying which check did not pass, and let the caretaker know before noon on Friday. The note should identify the issue with the drain or latch, not merely say that the pump is still downstairs, so the caretaker knows what needs attention. Use the same checks for both parts before deciding which action to take."}]
